# Specification contract — planned, not implemented

Draft only after architecture. Include every applicable field from the authoritative specification: objective, business outcome, users, channels, success criteria, scope, scenarios, responsibilities, architecture, instructions, knowledge, skills, tools/actions, flows, Dataverse, external systems, identity, permissions, confirmations, failures, escalation, observability, ALM, functional/resilience requirements, evaluation, acceptance, release gates, assumptions, dependencies, blockers.

Every mandatory requirement has a unique stable `REQ-NNN` ID. Approval is an explicit human transition; generation alone cannot approve. At approval hash `.agent-factory/spec.md` with SHA-256 and persist `approved_spec_sha256`. Check before build, resume, and final verification.
